test_title: SSC Stenographer 2025 Official Paper (Held On: 08 Aug, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Which of the following correctly pairs the initiative with its primary objective from India's viewpoint?

options.text: Chabahar Port - Access Central Asia via Iran
QUAD - Strengthening oil diplomacy in Gulf
IMEC - Maritime security in South China Sea

solution:
The correct answer is __**Chabahar Port - Access Central Asia via Iran**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Chabahar Port is strategically located in southeastern Iran and acts as India's gateway to Central Asia and Afghanistan, bypassing Pakistan.
 
• India has invested in the development of the Chabahar Port to enhance trade and economic connectivity in the region.
 
• It serves as a critical element of India’s “Connect Central Asia Policy,” which aims to strengthen ties with Central Asian countries.
 
• Chabahar Port facilitates the International North-South Transport Corridor (INSTC), enabling efficient and cost-effective trade routes between India, Iran, and Eurasia.
 
• This port is crucial for India's energy diplomacy, as it provides access to resources from Central Asia and improves regional geopolitical influence.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **International North-South Transport Corridor (INSTC)**

 
 
• A 7,200 km long multimodal transportation network connecting India, Iran, Russia, and Central Asia.
 
• Aims to reduce transit costs and delivery time compared to conventional trade routes.
 
• Key strategic initiative to boost India’s trade and connectivity within the Eurasian region.
 
 
 
• **Geopolitical Significance of Chabahar Port**
 
 
• Chabahar provides India a foothold in Iran, enhancing its strategic and economic presence in the region.
 
• The port counters China’s Belt and Road Initiative by offering an alternative trade route.
 
• It strengthens India-Afghanistan connectivity, especially for humanitarian aid and trade.
 
 
 
• **India’s Connect Central Asia Policy**
 
 
• Launched in 2012 to deepen engagement with Central Asian nations.
 
• Focuses on energy security, trade, cultural ties, and regional connectivity.
 
• Chabahar Port is a key infrastructure development under this policy.
 
 
 
• **India-Iran Relations in Context of Chabahar**
 
 
• India and Iran signed agreements for port development and strategic cooperation in 2016.
 
• Iran’s Chabahar Port complements India’s foreign policy objectives for regional stability and connectivity.
 
• Sanctions on Iran have posed challenges but efforts to mitigate them are ongoing.
